selector.rationale: The presence of atypical lymphocytes with epidermotropism, dense dermal infiltrate, and positive immunohistochemical staining for CD2, CD3, CD4, and CD45RO support Mycosis Fungoides. The clinical presentation of itchy eruptions, dry scaly patches, and dome-shaped nodules also align with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Sézary Syndrome
rejected.why: The absence of atypical cells in peripheral blood and lack of strong evidence for Sézary Syndrome-specific findings

rejected.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: While some findings could suggest Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, the specific details provided better fit Mycosis Fungoides
